name: The Internet has brought great convenience to our daily life, but it also brings some challenges.
trans: 互联网给我们的日常生活带来了极大便利，但也带来了一些挑战。

name: We should make full use of online resources to improve our learning efficiency.
trans: 我们应该充分利用在线资源来提高学习效率。

name: Smartphones make it easier for us to communicate with others, but overuse may lead to distraction.
trans: 智能手机使我们更容易与他人交流，但过度使用可能导致分心。

name: Some students are addicted to social media and spend too much time online.
trans: 一些学生沉迷于社交媒体，花太多时间上网。

name: It is important for us to distinguish true information from false information on the Internet.
trans: 对我们来说，辨别网络信息真伪很重要。

name: We should protect our personal privacy and never easily give out personal information online.
trans: 我们应该保护个人隐私，绝不轻易在网上泄露个人信息。

name: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we study, work and live.
trans: 人工智能正在改变我们学习、工作和生活的方式。

name: Online learning provides us with flexible access to abundant resources, but it requires strong self-discipline.
trans: 在线学习使我们能够灵活获取丰富资源，但它需要很强的自律。

name: While enjoying the convenience of mobile payment, we should also pay attention to data security.
trans: 在享受移动支付便利的同时，我们也应注意数据安全。

name: Technological innovation has greatly improved our work and study efficiency.
trans: 科技创新大大提高了我们的工作和学习效率。

name: We should strike a balance between online and offline life instead of being controlled by our phones.
trans: 我们应该平衡线上与线下生活，而不是被手机控制。

name: Developing digital literacy is essential for young people in the digital age.
trans: 在数字时代，培养数字素养对年轻人至关重要。

name: The Internet should be a tool for learning and communication rather than a source of addiction.
trans: 互联网应是学习和交流的工具，而不是沉迷的来源。

name: Face-to-face communication is still important, even though social media is widely used.
trans: 尽管社交媒体被广泛使用，面对面交流仍然很重要。

name: It is widely acknowledged that the Internet has changed our life in many ways.
trans: 众所周知，互联网在许多方面改变了我们的生活。

name: There is no denying that technology brings both opportunities and challenges.
trans: 不可否认，科技既带来机遇也带来挑战。

name: While technology brings convenience, it also causes problems such as privacy leakage and Internet addiction.
trans: 虽然科技带来便利，但也造成隐私泄露和网瘾等问题。

name: Only by using technology reasonably can we enjoy its benefits and avoid its harm.
trans: 只有合理使用科技，我们才能享受其益处并避免其危害。

name: As college students, we should improve our digital literacy and distinguish true information from false information.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该提高数字素养，辨别信息真伪。

name: Taking a reasonable attitude toward the Internet enables us to make it a useful tool rather than a master.
trans: 以合理态度对待互联网，使我们能把它变成有用工具而不是主人。
